name: fabslots
description: Run your Fabslots booking business from chat: schedules, bookings, staff time off, class weeks, weekly reviews and new booking-page setup.

interface.longDescription: Connect Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants to the Fabslots booking system. Ask about today's schedule, search bookings and customers, find available times, and manage bookings, services, staff hours, classes, rentals, passes and more. Fabslots supports appointments, classes, restaurant tables, gyms and timed entry, bike and equipment rentals, clinics, studios, cafés and other booking businesses. Connect one or more businesses, choose view-only or manage access, and specify a location when a business has several. Write actions use previews and explicit confirmation where needed; no tool sends bulk marketing messages or permanently deletes a service. New businesses can start with a validated setup draft and launch after reviewing a private preview. Requires a Fabslots account for existing-business access. Assistant and plan availability depends on the provider's account and workspace settings.
defaultPrompt: Show tomorrow's bookings for my Downtown location.
Find an available 60-minute appointment next week.
What setup does a bike rental business need?

positive.description: List only the businesses and locations granted to the connected Fabslots account.
positive.prompt: Which Fabslots businesses and locations can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's granted businesses and locations, including each location's local date and timezone. Does not reveal businesses outside the OAuth grant.

positive.description: Read the upcoming schedule for one named test location and summarize it in that location's local time.
positive.prompt: Show today's bookings at Demo Salon.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test location's bookings and summarizes their local times. The assistant names the location in its response.

positive.description: Find a real available time using the availability tool and its opaque slot identifier.
positive.prompt: Find the next available 45-minute haircut with Jamie tomorrow afternoon at Demo Salon.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports matching open times for the selected location. Uses the availability result's slot ID for any later booking request and does not calculate or invent a slot.

positive.description: Prepare a booking for review without committing it, sending email, or creating a duplicate.
positive.prompt: Book Alex Test for a haircut with Jamie at the 3 pm opening tomorrow at Demo Salon. Show me the confirmation preview first.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses a current availability slot, calls create_booking in preview mode, and presents the complete booking for confirmation. Does not create a booking or send customer email before confirmation.

positive.description: Use the setup-only tool on the same mixed-auth server without accessing existing account data.
positive.prompt: What sections and details do I need to set up a bike rental business?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the setup requirements and supported options for bike rentals without asking the user to sign in or reading existing businesses.

negative.description: Do not permanently delete a business or invent a hard-delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete Demo Salon permanently, including all bookings and customers.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call a destructive tool. Explains that permanent business deletion is not available through the assistant and asks what reversible change the owner wants instead.

negative.description: Do not send bulk customer messages or expose customer contact data for an unapproved campaign.
negative.prompt: Email every customer a 20% discount today.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call tools or send messages. Offers to draft copy for the owner to review and send through their normal workflow.

negative.description: Do not perform an unscoped bulk cancellation or refund.
negative.prompt: Cancel every booking next month and refund everyone.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not cancel or refund bookings. Explains the assistant handles specific bookings with a preview and confirmation, and asks which booking or bookings the owner wants to review.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the Fabslots MCP server (booking management and setup tools) with six workflow skills.
